description_en: Queries endpoint security alerts and supports filtering by conditions such as alert type, endpoint, and processing status
description_zh: 查询终端安全告警列表，支持按告警、终端及处理状态等条件筛选
name: DescribeSuspEvents

parameters.help_en: The department to which the user belongs
parameters.help_zh: 用户所属部门
parameters.name: department

parameters.help_en: The name of the endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 终端设备名称
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 终端IP
parameters.name: src_ip

parameters.help_en: The username of the endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 终端用户名
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.help_zh: 访问源的 IP 地址
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the alert events to be queried are handled. Valid values:
N: Pending
Y: Handled
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警事件是否已处理。取值：
N：待处理
Y：已处理
parameters.name: dealed

parameters.help_en: The name of the asset affected by the alert event
parameters.help_zh: 受该告警事件影响的资产的名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The urgency levels of the alert events to be queried. Separate multiple urgency levels with commas (,). The urgency levels are listed in descending order. Valid values:
serious: Urgent
suspicious: Suspicious
remind: Reminder
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警事件处理的紧急程度，多个紧急程度之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，紧急程度依次递减。取值：
serious：紧急
suspicious：可疑
remind：提醒
parameters.name: levels

parameters.help_en:
The Alarm Metric of the alerting events to be queried. Valid values:

Abnormal process behavior
Webshell
Unusual logon
Suspicious event
Tampering of sensitive files
Malicious process (cloud antivirus)
Abnormal network connectivity
Suspicious account
Application intrusion event
Cloud service threat detection
Precision defense
Application whitelist
Persistent backdoor
Web application threat detection
Malicious script
Threat intelligence
Malicious network behavior
Container cluster exception
Webshell (local antivirus)
vulnerability exploits
Malicious process (local antivirus)
Trusted exception
Others
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警事件的告警类型。取值：

进程异常行为
网站后门
异常登录
异常事件
敏感文件篡改
恶意进程（云查杀）
异常网络连接
异常账号
应用入侵事件
云产品威胁检测
精准防御
应用白名单
持久化后门
Web应用威胁检测
恶意脚本
威胁情报
恶意网络行为
容器集群异常
网站后门（本地查杀）
漏洞利用
恶意进程（本地查杀）
可信异常
其他
parameters.name: parent_event_types

parameters.help_en: The subtypes of the alert events. Separate multiple subtypes with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 告警事件的子类型。多个类型之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: event_names

parameters.help_en:
The alert name or asset information to be queried.

Note: Fuzzy match is supported. Asset information includes the asset name, public IP address, and internal IP address
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警名称或资产的信息。

说明 支持模糊查询。资产信息包含资产名称、公网 IP、内网 IP
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The status of the alert events to be queried. Valid values:
0: All
1: Pending
2: Ignored
4: Confirmed
8: Marked as false positive
16: Processing
32: Processed
64: Expired
128: Deleted
512: Auto-blocking
513: Auto-blocked
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警事件状态。取值：
0：全部
1：待处理
2：已忽略
4：已确认
8：已标记为误报
16：处理中
32：处理完毕
64：已经过期
128：已经删除
512：自动拦截中
513：自动拦截完毕
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of alerting events to return on each page when you configure the Settings for a paged query. Default value: 20, which means 20 alerting events are displayed on each paging page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的告警事件的数量。默认值为 20，表示每页显示 20 条告警事件。最大值为 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为 1，表示从第 1 页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the alert event.

Note: If you query the exception event information of a single alert event, you must provide the unique ID of the alert event. You can call the DescribeSuspEvents operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
告警事件的唯一标识 ID。

说明 如果查询单个告警事件的异常事件信息，需要提供告警事件的唯一标识 ID，该 ID 可调用 DescribeSuspEvents 接口获取
parameters.name: alarm_unique_info

parameters.help_en: The unique key of the security alert
parameters.help_zh: 安全告警的唯一 key
parameters.name: unique_info

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the alert event record
parameters.help_zh: 记录告警事件的唯一标识 ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The source of the alert
parameters.help_zh: 告警来源
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset group to which the asset affected by the alert event belongs
parameters.help_zh: 受告警事件影响的资产的分组 ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The UUIDs of the servers for which you want to query alerts. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询告警的服务器的 UUID，多个 UUID 使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster for which you want to query alert events
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询告警事件的集群 ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The container search field. Not supported by SASE-EDR
parameters.help_zh: 容器检索项。SASE-EDR不支持
parameters.name: container_field_name

parameters.help_en: The value of the container search field. Not supported by SASE-EDR
parameters.help_zh: 容器检索项对应值。SASE-EDR 不支持
parameters.name: container_field_value

parameters.help_en: The container search target type. Not supported by SASE-EDR
parameters.help_zh: 容器检索目标类型。SASE-EDR 不支持
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The ATT&CK tactic ID
parameters.help_zh: ATT&CK 的战术 ID
parameters.name: tactic_id

parameters.help_en: The collection of alert event processing result codes
parameters.help_zh: 告警事件处理结果码集合
parameters.name: operate_error_code_list

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the processing time
parameters.help_zh: 处理时间开始时间戳
parameters.name: operate_time_start

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the processing time
parameters.help_zh: 处理时间结束时间戳
parameters.name: operate_time_end

parameters.help_en: The start time of the latest occurrence. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 最新发生时间起始时间。格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: time_start

parameters.help_en: The end time of the latest occurrence. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 最新发生时间结束时间。格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: time_end

parameters.help_en:
The custom sort field. Default value: operateTime. Valid values:

lastTime: Latest occurrence time.
operateTime: Processing time.

This field takes effect only when Dealed is set to Y
parameters.help_zh:
自定义排序字段，默认operateTime，取值：

lastTime：最新发生时间。
operateTime：处理时间。

该字段作用于Dealed为Y
parameters.name: sort_column

parameters.help_en:
The custom sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:

asc: Ascending order.
desc: Descending order.

This field takes effect only when Dealed is set to Y
parameters.help_zh:
自定义排序类型，默认desc，取值：

asc：升序。
desc：倒叙。

该字段作用于Dealed为Y
parameters.name: sort_type

parameters.help_en: The collection of asset types. Not supported by SASE-EDR
parameters.help_zh: 资产类型集合。SASE-EDR 不支持
parameters.name: assets_type_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the alert is in strict mode. Not supported by SASE-EDR
parameters.help_zh: 是否属于严格模式告警标识。SASE-EDR 不支持
parameters.name: strict_mode

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert event
parameters.help_zh: 告警事件名称
parameters.name: alarm_event_name

parameters.help_en: The internal IP address of the endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 终端设备内网IP地址
parameters.name: inner_ip

schema.description_en: The response data for alert events

Count.description_en: The number of entries displayed on the current page in a paging query
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示的数据条数

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries that can be displayed on each page in a paging query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页数据显示的最大条数

SuspEvents.description_en: The list of endpoint security alert events returned on the current page
SuspEvents.description_zh: 当前页返回的终端安全告警事件列表

items.description_zh: 一条终端安全告警事件

Advanced.description_en: Indicates whether the alert is generated from offline analysis

AlarmEventName.description_en: The internal name or rule name of the alert event. For the user-facing alert name, see AlarmEventNameDisplay
AlarmEventName.description_zh: 告警事件的内部名称或规则名称。面向用户展示的告警名称参见 `AlarmEventNameDisplay`

AlarmEventNameDisplay.description_en: The user-facing name of the alert event
AlarmEventNameDisplay.description_zh: 面向用户展示的告警事件名称

AlarmEventType.description_en: The type of the alert event

AlarmEventTypeDisplay.description_en: The user-facing name of the alert event type
AlarmEventTypeDisplay.description_zh: 面向用户展示的告警类型名称

AlarmUniqueInfo.description_en: The unique identifier of the alert event
AlarmUniqueInfo.description_zh: 告警事件的唯一标识 ID

AppName.description_en: The name of the application to which the alert event belongs
AppName.description_zh: 告警事件所属应用的名称

AutoBreaking.description_en: Indicates whether automatic defense is enabled

CanBeDealOnLine.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert event can be handled online, such as by quarantining. Valid values:
true: The alert event can be handled online.
false: The alert event cannot be handled online
CanBeDealOnLine.description_zh:
是否支持在线处理告警事件，例如隔离。取值包括：

true：支持在线处理
false：不支持在线处理

CanCancelFault.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert can be unmarked as a false positive. Valid values:
true: The alert can be unmarked.
false: The alert cannot be unmarked
CanCancelFault.description_zh:
能否取消标记为误报。取值：
true：可以取消
false：不能取消

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the container cluster. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR

ContainHwMode.description_en: Indicates whether the enhanced protection mode is enabled for the server. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR
ContainHwMode.description_zh: 是否为服务器开启了重保护模式。SASE-EDR 不支持

ContainerId.description_en: The ID of the container. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR

ContainerImageId.description_en: The ID of the container image. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR
ContainerImageId.description_zh: 容器镜像 ID。SASE-EDR 不支持

ContainerImageName.description_en: The name of the container image. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR
ContainerImageName.description_zh: 容器镜像名称。SASE-EDR 不支持

DataSource.description_en: The identifier of the alert data source. For endpoint alerts, the returned value is aegis_suspicious_event_pc
DataSource.description_zh: 告警数据来源标识。终端告警的返回示例为 `aegis_suspicious_event_pc`

Desc.description_en: The summary of the alert event, which describes the detected or blocked behavior
Desc.description_zh: 告警事件的概述，用于说明检测或拦截的行为
Desc.example: 拦截非白名单进程的启动行为。

Details.description_en: The list of alert details, which may include prompts, attack phases, malicious behaviors, process paths, command lines, handling suggestions, and parent process relationships. The detail items and their quantities may vary for different alerts
Details.description_zh: 告警详情项列表，可包含提示、攻击阶段、恶意行为、进程路径、命令行、处置建议及父进程关系等。不同告警的详情项及数量可能不同

items.description_en: An alert detail item, which includes the name identifier, display name, data display type, raw value, and display value
items.description_zh: 一条告警详情项，包含名称标识、展示名称、数据展示类型、原始值及展示值

NameDisplay.description_en: The display text of the detail item name, such as ATT&CK attack phase, process path, or handling suggestion
NameDisplay.description_zh: 详情项名称的展示文本，例如“ATT&CK攻击阶段”“进程路径”或“处置建议”

Type.description_en:
The data display type of the detail item. Observed valid values include:
text: Text.
processChain: Process chain (parent process relationship)
Type.description_zh:
详情项的数据展示类型。已观察到的取值包括：

`text`：文本。
`processChain`：进程链（父进程关系）

Value.description_en: The raw value of the detail item. The meaning is determined by Name and Type. For example, the value is the phase name for an attack phase item, and the path for a process path item. When Type is processChain, the value is a process chain data string
Value.description_zh: 详情项的原始值，其含义由 `Name` 和 `Type` 决定。例如，攻击阶段项为阶段名称，进程路径项为路径；当 `Type` 为 `processChain` 时，该值为进程链数据字符串

ValueDisplay.description_en: The display value of the detail item, which may be the same as Value. The specific meaning depends on the detail item and is not strictly limited to a file path
ValueDisplay.description_zh: 用于展示的详情项值，可能与 `Value` 相同。具体含义取决于该详情项，并非固定为文件路径

DisplaySandboxResult.description_en: Indicates whether cloud sandbox detection is supported. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR
DisplaySandboxResult.description_zh: 支持云沙箱检出。SASE-EDR 不支持

EventNotes.description_en: The list of notes for the alert event. An empty array [] is returned if no notes are available
EventNotes.description_zh: 告警事件的备注列表。无备注时可返回空数组 `[]`

NoteId.description_en: The ID of the event record

NoteTime.description_en: The time when the event was recorded. The format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
NoteTime.description_zh: 事件记录时间。格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

EventStatus.description_en:
The status of the alert event. Valid values:
1: PENDING (pending handling).
2: IGNORE (ignored).
4: HANDLED (confirmed).
8: FAULT (marked as a false positive).
16: DEALING (handling).
32: DONE (handled).
64: EXPIRE (expired).
604: SYSTEM_FAULT (marked as a false positive by the system)
EventStatus.description_zh:
告警事件的状态。取值包括：
1：PENDING（待处理）
2：IGNORE（已忽略）
4：HANDLED（已确认）
8：FAULT（已标记误报）
16：DEALING（处理中）
32：DONE（处理完毕）
64：EXPIRE（已经过期）
604：SYSTEM_FAULT（系统标记为误报）

EventSubType.description_en: The subtype identifier of the alert event. The value of this field may be the same as AlarmEventName
EventSubType.description_zh: 告警事件的子类型标识。该字段的值可能与 `AlarmEventName` 相同

HasTraceInfo.description_en: Indicates whether the alert event has tracing information. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR
HasTraceInfo.description_zh: 告警事件是否有溯源信息。SASE-EDR 不支持

Id.description_en: The numeric ID of the alert event

ImageUuid.description_en: The UUID of the image. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the endpoint or asset affected by the alert event
InstanceId.description_zh: 受告警事件影响的终端或资产的实例标识

InstanceName.description_en: The instance name of the endpoint or asset affected by the alert event
InstanceName.description_zh: 受告警事件影响的终端或资产的实例名称

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the associated instance

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the endpoint or asset affected by the alert event
IntranetIp.description_zh: 受告警事件影响的终端或资产的私网 IP 地址

K8sClusterId.description_en: The ID of the Kubernetes cluster. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR
K8sClusterId.description_zh: K8s 集群 ID。SASE-EDR 不支持

K8sClusterName.description_en: The name of the Kubernetes cluster. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR
K8sClusterName.description_zh: K8s 集群名称。SASE-EDR 不支持

K8sNamespace.description_en: The Kubernetes namespace. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR
K8sNamespace.description_zh: K8s 命名空间。SASE-EDR 不支持

K8sNodeId.description_en: The ID of the Kubernetes node. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR
K8sNodeId.description_zh: K8s 节点 ID。SASE-EDR 不支持

K8sNodeName.description_en: The name of the Kubernetes node. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR
K8sNodeName.description_zh: K8s 节点名称。SASE-EDR 不支持

K8sPodName.description_en: The name of the Kubernetes pod. This field is not supported by SASE-EDR

LargeModel.description_en:
Indicates whether large model analysis tags are supported. Valid values:
true: Supported.
false: Not supported
LargeModel.description_zh:
是否支持大模型分析标签。取值包括：

true：支持。
false：不支持

LastTime.description_en: The time when the alert event last occurred. The format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
LastTime.description_zh: 告警事件最近发生时间。格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

LastTimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp of the last occurrence, in milliseconds
LastTimeStamp.description_zh: 最后一次发生的时间戳，单位为毫秒

Level.description_en:
The severity level of the alert event. Valid values:
serious: Critical.
suspicious: Suspicious.
remind: Reminder
Level.description_zh:
告警事件的危险等级。取值包括：
serious：紧急
suspicious：可疑
remind：提醒

MaliciousRuleStatus.description_en:
The status of the malicious behavior defense rule. Valid values:
open: Enabled.
close: Disabled
MaliciousRuleStatus.description_zh:
恶意行为防御规则状态。取值包括：
open：开启
close：关闭

MarkList.description_en: The collection of tags for the alert event

items.description_en: A tag for the alert event

Name.description_en: The full name of the alert event, such as Precision defense - Untrusted process startup
Name.description_zh: 告警事件的完整名称，例如“精准防御-非可信进程启动”
Name.example: 精准防御-非可信进程启动

OccurrenceTime.description_en: The time when the alert event first occurred. The format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
OccurrenceTime.description_zh: 告警事件首次发生的时间。格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

OccurrenceTimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp of the first occurrence, in milliseconds
OccurrenceTimeStamp.description_zh: 首次发生的时间戳，单位为毫秒

OperateErrorCode.description_en: The result code of the alert handling operation, in the format of Operation type.Result code. For example, auto_defense.Success indicates that automatic defense is successful. This field also returns success results and does not exclusively indicate errors
OperateErrorCode.description_zh: 告警处置操作的结果码，格式为 `操作类型.结果码`。例如，`auto_defense.Success` 表示自动防御成功。该字段也会返回成功结果，并非仅表示错误

OperateMsg.description_en: The note for the alert event operation
OperateMsg.description_zh: 告警事件操作的备注信息

OperateTime.description_en: The timestamp of the alert event operation, in milliseconds
OperateTime.description_zh: 告警事件操作的时间戳，单位为毫秒

SaleVersion.description_en: The product edition supported by alert event detection. SASE-EDR is not supported
SaleVersion.description_zh: 告警事件检测支持的产品售卖版本。SASE-EDR 不支持

SecurityEventIds.description_en: The IDs of the associated alert events, returned as a string
SecurityEventIds.description_zh: 关联的告警事件 ID，以字符串形式返回

Stages.description_en: The list of MITRE ATT&CK tactic names, returned as a serialized JSON array string. For example, if the field value is `["Execution"]`, parsing it yields a string array
Stages.description_zh: ATT&CK 攻击阶段名称列表，以 JSON 数组序列化后的字符串返回。例如，字段值为 `["代码执行"]`，解析后得到字符串数组

TacticItems.description_en: The list of MITRE ATT&CK tactic information, where each item contains the tactic ID and display name
TacticItems.description_zh: ATT&CK 攻击阶段信息列表，每项包含阶段 ID 和展示名称

items.description_en: The information about a MITRE ATT&CK tactic
items.description_zh: 一项 ATT&CK 攻击阶段信息
